claim_blocks.paragraph: OONI anomaly index reports 58.8 percent across 273,432 completed measurements, OONI in-path middlebox index reports 1.32 percent across 9,576 completed middlebox tests, and Inside-China fixed DNS panel reports 1.0 ratio across 5 qualifying answered measurement domains. The three cited values do not share a population, protocol, test family, denominator, or even a common unit, while measurements with the same independence-group identifier count only once. The cited measurements record observable interference within their named methods, but they cannot be combined into one defensible national filtering percentage.
